::: fragment

:::

## Tools of the trade

### Ultrasound tongue imaging

::::::: {layout-ncol="2"}
:::: {}
**Pros?**

::: fragment
- Relatively non-invasive.
:::
::::

:::: {}
**Cons?**

::: fragment
- Can *only* image fleshy bits.

- Can't image across an air gap.

- Relatively low frame rate.
:::
::::
:::::::

## Tools of the trade

### Electromagnetic Articulography (EMA)

::: {layout="[[25, 75]]"}
![Credit: Will Styler](images/ema_will_18.jpg){fig-align="center" width="100%"}

![](images/M4_14_mview.jpg){fig-align="center" width="100%"}
:::

## Tools of the trade

### Electromagnetic Articulography (EMA)

::::::: {layout-ncol="2"}
:::: {}
**Pros?**

::: fragment
- Very high time resolution.

- Spatially precise.
:::
::::

:::: {}
**Cons?**

::: fragment
- Invasive.

- Harder to visualize.

- Expensive equipment.
:::
::::
:::::::

## Tools of the trade

### MRI

::::::: {layout-ncol="2"}
:::: {}
**Pros?**

::: fragment
- Non invasive.

- High quality images.
:::
::::

:::: {}
**Cons?**

::: fragment
- Low frame rate (but improving).

- *Very* loud.

- Speakers must be lying down.

- Expensive equipment.
:::
::::
:::::::
